g.text: RETAIL STORE SETUP • 100% OFFLINE LOCAL NETWORK
How Trength™ Works in Your Store
Zero internet required. Sales reps scan QR tags with mobile phones and sync instantly to your Trength Server PC.
Equipped with everyday mobile smartphones. Zero barcode guns needed.
Syncs live to Trength Server PC
Sends bill instantly to Server PC
• Zero SIM recharge or data fees
• Acts as wireless bridge to PC
Your standard desktop PC acts as the entire Trength Server. No server rack needed.
Live Order Received: Sales Rep 1 scanned Item #10842
Runs Database + Tray App + CommandCenter Locally
Sales reps scan item QR tags anywhere on floor
using phone camera. No barcode gun needed.
Data transfers locally over store Wi-Fi router.
100% offline. Zero internet or recharge needed.
Counter PC displays cart, prints customer receipt
and QR item tags instantly via USB cables.
